fieldNotes.location: Roster geocode (40.6733,-89.5990) moved 2.4 km (GEOMETRIC_CENTER) but landed inside the historic Caterpillar East Peoria works on the east bank of the Illinois River. Confirmed: large old multi-building industrial plant with rooftop monitor skylights, Cat component (undercarriage/casting) laydown yards, and an adjacent rail yard with spurs. Address 100 NE Adams St is actually the Caterpillar downtown HQ/Visitors Center across the river; the East Peoria works is the manufacturing campus.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Whole campus enclosed by black metal and chain-link perimeter fencing (confirmed in multiple Street View panos). Truck access is via the east access road through fenced openings into the building/laydown areas; no open uncontrolled driveway. Building face entrance E1 visible from the road.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No standalone guard booth visible from public roads - gates are at building/fence openings typical of an old urban works. Classified remoteGs (controlled gate, no road-visible booth); low confidence.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Old urban plant - building faces sit close to the access road; short approach, little internal stacking.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Plant fronts public city streets with residential homes directly opposite on the south; a truck queue at a gate would sit on a public street.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers and a large component/casting laydown yard north of the historic building; trailer drop capacity ~30.
fieldNotes.railServed: Large rail yard immediately south/east of the plant with spurs running into the property; the plant is historically rail-served.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Continuous campus of 6+ large connected/adjacent manufacturing buildings (historic East Peoria works).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~20 dock doors estimated; many obscured by the old building's continuous wall faces - low confidence.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense urban riverfront industrial setting in East Peoria with residential streets abutting the plant.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~230 acres for the fenced East Peoria works including laydown yards - approximate.

citations.claim: Caterpillar confirms a temporary one-week layoff at the East Peoria facility citing customer demand (temporary, not a closure).
6,000th D11 (built exclusively at East Peoria) rolled off the line Oct 2024 (corroborating only).

verification.rationale: CAT-operated track-type-tractor/component campus, builds D11 exclusively; only temporary layoffs, no sale/closure (the sold IL plant was Aurora).
